queries:
WITH product_volumes AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS quantity
    FROM Order_Items
    GROUP BY product_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT quantity, quantity / NULLIF(SUM(quantity) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM product_volumes
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share
    FROM product_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(ps.quantity) AS combined_quantity,
    AVG(ps.share) AS mean_share,
    AVG(ps.share - om.mean_share) AS mean_excess
FROM product_shares AS ps
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
WHERE ps.share > om.mean_share

WITH product_volumes AS (
    SELECT p.product_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)), 0) AS quantity
    FROM Products AS p
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT quantity,
           COALESCE(quantity / NULLIF(SUM(quantity) OVER (), 0), 0) AS share
    FROM product_volumes
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM product_shares
)
SELECT SUM(ps.quantity) AS combined_quantity,
       AVG(ps.share) AS mean_share,
       AVG(ps.share - a.share) AS mean_excess
FROM product_shares AS ps
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE ps.share > a.share

WITH product_volumes AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM Order_Items
    GROUP BY product_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT
        row_count,
        1.0 * row_count / SUM(row_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM product_volumes
),
benchmarked AS (
    SELECT
        row_count,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER () AS average_product_share
    FROM product_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(row_count) AS combined_row_count,
    AVG(share) AS mean_share,
    AVG(share - average_product_share) AS mean_excess
FROM benchmarked
WHERE share > average_product_share

WITH product_shares AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS row_count,
        COALESCE(
            1.0 * COUNT(oi.order_item_id) /
            NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items), 0),
            0
        ) AS share
    FROM Products AS p
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share
    FROM product_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(ps.row_count) AS combined_row_count,
    AVG(ps.share) AS mean_share,
    AVG(ps.share - o.mean_share) AS mean_excess
FROM product_shares AS ps
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE ps.share > o.mean_share

WITH product_order_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM Order_Items
    GROUP BY product_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        order_count,
        1.0 * order_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS order_share
    FROM product_order_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_share) AS mean_order_share
    FROM product_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(order_count) AS combined_order_count,
    AVG(order_share) AS mean_share,
    AVG(order_share - mean_order_share) AS mean_excess
FROM product_shares
CROSS JOIN average_share
WHERE order_share > mean_order_share

WITH product_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM Order_Items
    GROUP BY product_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT
        order_count,
        1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM product_counts
),
compared AS (
    SELECT
        order_count,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_mean_share
    FROM product_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(order_count) AS combined_counts,
    AVG(share) AS mean_share,
    AVG(share - overall_mean_share) AS mean_excess
FROM compared
WHERE share > overall_mean_share
